findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 稱鋼鐵市場高度競爭，內外國業者眾多，Nucor 主要以價格與服務競爭；外國對手多受國家補貼
findings.excerpt: These markets are highly competitive with many domestic and foreign firms participating, and, as a result of this highly competitive environment, we find that we primarily compete on price and service.

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因素：持續面對其他鋼廠與進口品在價格、品質、服務上的競爭
findings.excerpt: We face ongoing competition from other steel producers and imports that compete with our products on price, quality and service.
